_description: Pinecone vector store operation log → AKSI control ID mapping. Pinecone is the dominant managed vector store in production agent stacks; every query/upsert/delete/fetch operation is a data-access governance event. Each operation record produces one EvaluationResult. The operation type drives the primary control mapping, with additional flags for over-fetch (top_k > threshold), un-scoped queries (no filter), raw vector exposure (include_values=true on fetch), failures (status=failure), and cross-namespace access patterns within a single trace/api_key (scope expansion). Filter values, vector data, and metadata payloads are NEVER stored — only key names and counts.
